A meta-analysis18 did not support this hypothesis, although a modest reduction in risk or an effect with higher doses of statins could not be ruled out. • Other potential chemopreventive agents on the basis of epidemiological evidence include folic acid, selenium, and menopausal HRT.1-3 For the suggestion that folate may have dual modulatory effects on carcinogenesis, see Carcinogenicity, under Folic Acid, p.1940.
